description: Detect the excitation windows of a measurement and compare them with the current ones; nothing changes until Use detected windows is pressed.

sections.title: Measurement
sections.description: The photon stream the windows are detected from: a photons row of the Datasets workspace (drop a TTTR file on ChiSurf to add one).
Pick the measurement in the workspace list; it is read and its windows detected.
Which measurement (or live decay) the detection used.

buttons.label: Detect
buttons.description: Find the excitation pulses (PIE: rising edges in the micro-time decays) or the µs-ALEX alternation (macro time) and propose windows.

buttons.label: Load example
buttons.description: Write a simulated two-colour PIE measurement (32 ps channels, pulses at 2 and 52 ns) into the workspace and detect its windows.

sections.title: Result
sections.description: What the data shows, how the current windows compare, and the proposal.
The verdict: PIE / µs-ALEX found, one pulse only (donor-only or not PIE), or unclear; and whether the current windows match.
Each finding of the check (a window outside the range, a pulse no window holds, a boundary cutting a pulse, a window mixing two pulses, a channel-width mismatch).
The micro-time decays (log counts) with the current window edges (grey) and the detected ones (orange).
Current and proposed windows side by side, in channels and nanoseconds, with the excitation each window holds.

columns.title: Window
columns.tooltip: Window name: prompt (donor excitation), delayed (acceptor excitation), or one per pulse.

columns.title: Current
columns.tooltip: The window as the setup has it, in the data's channels (converted when the setup gives another channel width).

columns.title: Detected
columns.tooltip: The detected window, in the data's channels: from a little before its pulse rises to where the next window starts.

columns.title: Detected (ns)
columns.tooltip: The detected window in nanoseconds from the start of the range.

columns.title: Excitation
columns.tooltip: Which excitation the window holds and which detectors see light in it.

buttons.label: Use detected windows
buttons.description: Replace the windows by the detected ones (and record the channel width they are in). Offered only when the data shows two or more excitations.
